cases.question: What cycle of corruption and renewal did Rashad describe?
cases.expected_answer_note: Rashad describes a cycle in which Abraham's religion and Muhammad's message were gradually corrupted by idolatry. Contemporary restoration creates another first generation that faces ridicule and receives a special rank analogous to the earliest followers.

cases.question: Why was the current group called a first generation?

cases.question: What three-hundred-year pattern was claimed?
cases.expected_answer_note: Rashad says Christianity and Islam were corrupted roughly three hundred years after Jesus and Muhammad. He contrasts the current movement, whose three-hundred-year point would coincide with the end of the world, and predicts millions of Quran-alone believers within fifty years or less.
